text:
sophie: FYI Acme (Dedicated) wants a per-tenant canary: 10% to v2 with strong isolation + an on-console toggle. Anyone on rollouts/routing g2g?

trevor: We can route by tenant today but not percentage splits per-tenant. Our rule engine handles `if tenant == "acme" then pool=acme-pool` but it won't do pct-based splits across variants. Also concerned about noisy neighbors if we use shared canary nodes.

maya: Propose two modes: isolated_canary (dedicated instances for tenant canaries) and shared_canary (shared canary pool with per-tenant caps). For enterprise/Dedicated default to isolated.

gennady: Telemetry needs: p50/p95/p99 lat, error rate, reject rate, tokens/min, and eval-derived quality deltas. Tag everything with tenant_id + rollout_id + variant.

trevor: Console: show tenant row with inline percent control + guard settings. Minimal API payload: {tenant, rollout_id, variants:[{name,pct}], guards:{max_qps,max_tokens,cpu_share}, fallback}.

sophie: Add telemetry_hooks and RBAC for tenant-scoped logs. Acme requires logs only accessible via their SSO and KMS tagging per tenant.

trevor: Implementation note: routing path must evaluate tenant header early and consult an in-memory KV for rollout entries (watch for updates). Avoid DB hits on request path.

maya: Enforcement layers: admission (hard reject over quota) and throttling/slow-path (soft limits). For Dedicated we should make admission the default.

gennady: Alerts: regression rate > 2x, p95 +200ms, error rate delta > 1%. Also materialize auto-rollback flag in the rollout record.

ops-bot: deploy-bot created rollout r-2026-03-13-acme-1 -> v2 @10% :rocket:

trevor: I'll write an RFC covering architecture, storage choice (etcd/consul/redis), and enforcement model. I'll scope a minimal API + console fields for an EOW demo.

maya: I'll prototype spawn/teardown flow for isolated_canary and the admission guard logic.

sophie: Can we ship a low-risk beta to Acme next week? They only want isolated_canary initially. :thumbsup:

trevor: I'll add a demo ticket and sync on platform call tomorrow 11am.

sophie: tagging @gennady for metric schema and @maya for prototype progress. Ping here if you hit blockers.
